schema.description: Invocation-scoped decisions for the complete pending approval batch.

run_id.description: ID of the run whose pending approvals are being answered. Must belong to the agent identified in the path.

responses.description: One decision per pending interaction. Interaction IDs must be unique.

items.description: Approve or reject the invocation identified by a pending interaction ID.

interaction_id.description: The interaction_id returned in the run's pending_interactions.

decision.description: The decision for this invocation only. Rejection follows normal workflow behavior.
